findings.title: What it is
findings.said: A plain wallet: someone's private key, no code.

findings.title: How long the wallet has existed
findings.said: Its first transaction was 6 months ago (block 6802423).

findings.title: Who paid for its first gas
findings.said: 0x0be4…5026 sent it 2 PROS 6 months ago, and it has sent 580 transactions of its own since.

findings.title: What the funder was doing
findings.said: Within an hour of funding it, 0x0be4…5026 sent PROS to 1 wallet. The funder itself is 6 months old with 2072 transactions.

findings.title: Approvals it left open
findings.said: Of 7 approvals we looked up on the chain, 2 are still open: none to a plain wallet, and no unlimited one to an unverified contract or one younger than 14 days.

findings.title: Who lets it move their tokens
findings.said: Nobody approved it to move their tokens in the last 100000 blocks (about 26 hours).

findings.title: Approvals given to it earlier
findings.said: Approvals older than the last 100000 blocks (about 26 hours) weren't scanned (no index lists them by spender).

unchecked.title: Approvals given to it earlier
unchecked.said: Approvals older than the last 100000 blocks (about 26 hours) weren't scanned (no index lists them by spender).
